append.detail: respond() in app/(main)/events/host-transfer-actions.ts flipped event_host_transfers.status with .eq(status, pending) but no .select() and only an if (error) branch; a zero-row PATCH is not a PostgREST error, so an accept that lost to a concurrent revoke or decline fell through to applyHost and moved events.host_space_id (the payee) after the offer was already resolved. The update is now a compare-and-set that returns rows (.select(id)) with a zero-row refusal (That host offer has already been resolved.) before applyHost and before notify, mirroring respondToShare. Pinned by app/(main)/events/host-transfer-actions.test.ts on a fake admin client: a landed flip writes host_space_id and notifies; a zero-row flip refuses, writes nothing to events and sends no notification. The status flip and host_space_id write remain non-atomic (needs one RPC, out of scope).
